name: Rex de Couraciel
original_name: レクス・ド・クラーシェル
source:
"I, Rex de Couraciel shall be the blade that clears your path!"

A knight of the Exlattle Order.

With his fresh, striking looks, courteous manners, and strong sense of duty, he could easily be called the ideal knight at first glance.

Yet when it comes to protecting the lives of the people, he will stop at nothing—even employing methods that stray far from the code of chivalry.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/crazy_chain/chara/]official website[/url]]
